hints.title: Hierarchical Path Tracking
hints.text: A path can only be created if its immediate parent directory already exists and the target path does not exist.

hints.title: Trie or Map Prefix Validation
hints.text: Extract the parent directory string by finding the last slash. Verify parent presence before inserting the new path.

hints.title: Path Map Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize map with root slash. For createPath, split parent = path[:rfind("/")]. If parent exists and path is absent, store value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: L: length of the path string
complexity.notes: Substring slicing and hash table lookup execute linearly relative to path length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding path lists on each query wastes linear time relative to total stored paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map of full paths provides constant component lookup over trie pointer dereferencing.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Parent path presence check and handling edge cases like duplicate or root paths.

solutions.approach: Hash Map with Parent Path Extraction
